title: Khata Manifest
description: JSON Schema for the manifest.json at the root of every .khata archive, aligned with the reference implementation (Bahi) at schema 12. The audit log, invoice series, period locks, and FY closings live in books.sqlite tables — not in the manifest; the manifest carries identity, integrity (books hash + audit-chain head + signing key), and lightweight history.

khataFormatVersion.description: The .khata format version this file conforms to. Semantic versioning.

schemaVersion.description: Internal SQLite schema version of books.sqlite. Bumped when the structure changes; the reference implementation is at 12.

workspaceId.description: Stable per-file workspace identifier (UUID). Local browser storage (keypair, settings) is keyed by this.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of first creation. Immutable after creation.

lastModifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent save.

company.description: Current company identity. Per-document historical identity is snapshotted on each transaction; this block is the current state, with a changeHistory trail for rename/identity-drift detection.

trade_name.description: Trade name if different from the legal name.

tan.description: 10-character TAN; required only for TDS deductors.

gstinStateCode.description: 2-digit GSTIN state code; derivable from the GSTIN.

changeHistory.description: Append-only trail of identity changes (name/GSTIN/etc.). Wrong-file detection on open walks this so a renamed company doesn't false-positive against an older copy.

uiTier.description: Progressive-unlock tier for the user-facing UI.

snapshots.description: Metadata for the rolling in-file save snapshots stored under snapshots/ in the archive.

integrity.description: Tamper-evidence anchors. booksHash pins the database bytes; auditHead is the latest audit-log entry's hash; signedBy is the current signing public key.

booksHash.description: SHA-256 of the current books.sqlite bytes, 64 lowercase hex (no prefix).

auditHead.description: Hash of the most recent audit_log entry (the chain head), 64 lowercase hex. See audit-log.md.

signedBy.description: Public key (JWK) of the keypair signing audit-log entries. Present only when the file is signed; absent/null for unsigned files.

modeHistory.description: Record of when the file was opened in owner vs CA mode.

recoveredFrom.description: Present only on files produced by corruption recovery; records the source file and the snapshot/audit head recovered from.
